title: Buffon 2006: two goals conceded, still second
checked: Buffon at WC 2006: 7 games, 5 clean sheets, 2 goals conceded, neither from open play: Zaccardo own goal v USA (1-1, 17 June) and Zidane's penalty in the final (Wikipedia Buffon, Ghanamma, Liquisearch); Yashin Award (Oneindia, Liquisearch). Final 9 July 2006, Berlin: Zidane 7' penalty off the bar, Materazzi 19' header from Pirlo's corner, Buffon tipped Zidane's 104' header from Sagnol's cross over, Italy 5-3 on penalties, all five Italian kicks scored (Wikipedia final, LJWorld/AP, 90min). Calciopoli: Juventus relegated to Serie B and stripped of the 2005 and 2006 titles; Cannavaro left for Real Madrid, Buffon stayed (Wikipedia scandal, Wikipedia 2006 Ballon d'Or). Vote: Cannavaro 173, Buffon 124, Henry 121 (Wikipedia, Topend). Cannavaro also FIFA World Player of the Year 2006 (Wikipedia). Yashin 1963 the only keeper to win it (Wikipedia Yashin, Wikipedia Ballon d'Or). The sanction is stated only as on record against the club; no person is accused. Gameplay: Zidane's penalty (the bar is not possible, so a plain penalty) and Buffon's save, gamecap specs/rob-buffon-2006.json.

lines.text: Two goals. That's all Gianluigi Buffon let in at the whole 2006 World Cup. He still didn't win the Ballon d'Or.
lines.say: Two goals. That's all Jahnlooeejee Boofon let in at the whole two thousand and six World Cup. He still didn't win the Balon Dor.

lines.text: Seven games. Five clean sheets. And not one goal from open play.
lines.say: Seven games. Five clean sheets. And not one goal from open play.

lines.text: The first was an own goal, by his own team-mate Zaccardo, against the USA.
lines.say: The first was an own goal, by his own team mate Zakkardoh, against the USA.

scene.note: Zaccardo's own goal: the only goal Buffon let in before the final

lines.text: The second? Zidane, in the final, seven minutes in. A chip, in off the crossbar.
lines.say: The second? Zeedan, in the final, seven minutes in. A chip, in off the crossbar.

lines.text: Materazzi headed Italy level. Then it went to extra time.
lines.say: Matterattsee headed Italy level. Then it went to extra time.

scene.note: Materazzi 19' · a header from Pirlo's corner

lines.text: A hundred and four minutes. Sagnol crosses. Zidane heads for the top corner. Buffon tips it over.
lines.say: A hundred and four minutes. Sanyol crosses. Zeedan heads for the top corner. Boofon tips it over.

lines.text: Penalties. Italy score all five. They win it five-three.
lines.say: Penalties. Italy score all five. They win it five three.

lines.text: World champions. And Buffon wins the Yashin Award, as the best keeper of the tournament.
lines.say: World champions. And Boofon wins the Yashin Award, as the best keeper of the tournament.

lines.text: Back home, chaos. Juventus are relegated to Serie B in the Calciopoli scandal, and stripped of two titles.
lines.say: Back home, chaos. Yooventus are relegated to Serie B in the Kalchohpohlee scandal, and stripped of two titles.

scene.headline: Juventus sent down to Serie B
scene.standfirst: The champions are relegated and stripped of their 2005 and 2006 titles after the Calciopoli scandal.

lines.text: The captain, Cannavaro, leaves for Real Madrid. Buffon stays with Juventus, in the second division.
lines.say: The captain, Kannahvaroh, leaves for Rayal Madrid. Boofon stays with Yooventus, in the second division.

lines.text: November. The Ballon d'Or goes to Cannavaro. Buffon is second, forty-nine points behind.
lines.say: November. The Balon Dor goes to Kannahvaroh. Boofon is second, forty nine points behind.

lines.text: To be fair, Cannavaro was immense too. He was the captain, and FIFA's player of the year.
lines.say: To be fair, Kannahvaroh was immense too. He was the captain, and FIFA's player of the year.

scene.headline: Was Buffon really robbed?
scene.standfirst: Cannavaro lifted the World Cup as captain and also won FIFA's World Player award. The defence in front of Buffon was his.

lines.text: But only one goalkeeper has ever won it. Lev Yashin, in 1963. Buffon never got closer than this.
lines.say: But only one goalkeeper has ever won it. Lev Yashin, in nineteen sixty three. Boofon never got closer than this.

lines.text: Two goals in seven games, neither from open play, and it still wasn't enough. That's the robbery.
lines.say: Two goals in seven games, neither from open play, and it still wasn't enough. That's the robbery.
